directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Sidorovich, why is your assortment so sparse? I thought I could buy equipment and even guns from you, but all you have is food and bandages. What do you supply the stalkers with?
entries.JA_current: Sidorovich, why is your assortment so sparse? I thought I could buy equipment and even guns from you, but all you have is food and bandages. What do you supply the stalkers with?
entries.JA_new: シドロヴィッチ、どうして品揃えがこんなに少ないんだ？ 装備や銃も買えると思ってたのに、食料と包帯しかない。ストーカーたちには何を売ってるんだ？

entries.EN: Eh, Marked One... What can I tell you? I used to have a lot of interesting things, and not so long ago. And now I don't. Don't ask me why, I don't want to talk about it. If you're so interested, you can ask that creature over there in the cabin at the edge of the village.
entries.JA_current: Eh, Marked One... What can I tell you? I used to have a lot of interesting things, and not so long ago. And now I don't. Don't ask me why, I don't want to talk about it. If you're so interested, you can ask that creature over there in the cabin at the edge of the village.
entries.JA_new: ああ、印付き……何と言えばいいか。少し前までは面白い品をたくさん持ってたんだが、今はもうない。なぜかは聞くな。話したくないんだ。そんなに気になるなら、村はずれの小屋にいるあの化け物に聞いてみろ。

entries.EN: I can't call him a stalker, and I can't call him a human. Anyway, enough about that.
entries.JA_current: I can't call him a stalker, and I can't call him a human. Anyway, enough about that.
entries.JA_new: あいつはストーカーとも呼べないし、人間とも呼べない。まあ、あの話はもういい。
